newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures dive on Thai baht float.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures dive on Thai baht float.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures fell sharply in heavy volume in Wednesday's morning session after the float of the Thai baht, with activity centred on three sheet grade, brokers said.
Thailand sent shock waves through Asian markets on Wednesday by floating the battered Baht, in a bid to keep the currency from spinning into a freefall.
"There's been some hectic activity in three sheet by Thai producers and market makers this morning following the baht float and the volume was quite huge," a local broker said.

"Three sheets were marked down about 4-1/2 U.S. cents this morning....But there's only one market-maker and he is stepping back from the pressure. If I were him I would go home for the day. We will be seeing more activity in the afternoon and volume will probably be larger that normal," another broker said.
August RSS3 was traded at around 95.00 U.S. cents a kg compared with Tuesday's settlement of 99.50 cents.
